text: We were very lucky to hire Deck Doctors to refinish our old mahogany deck. Unknown to us, the wood had rotted through in several places and was a true hazard which required much additional time and materials to repair. Deck Doctors first replaced the damaged wood, corrected the spacing to prevent future damage, and refinished the deck to our satisfaction. Their pricing was more than fair for the additional work and we are very happy with the results. Throughout this process, their communication, professionalism, and work ethic were outstanding. I highly recommend this company. By the way, we hired them to do our plowing too!

My deck was in pretty rough shape, so I hired Deck Doctors, which came from a referral from a friend of mine. Peter and Paul were both awesome to work with. They were very professional, knowledgeable, worked very hard, and got the job done quickly. They kept me informed along the way. I would highly recommend them to get your deck looking great!

We had a deck that really needed an enema! Judy & I (Richard) had many companies come to our home and we were ready to pick one of them on Monday. By fate, Judy went to the West Hartford Festival on Saturday, two days before we were going to hire one of the previous companies. With that said, Judy came home with a card she received from the Deck Dr. booth at the festival. Peter came out to our home and said he could give our deck the enema we were looking for! The rest is history—our deck is out of this world. In our opinion, no other company can come close. They took a zero deck and made it a hero. What more can Judy & I say but thanks!!!

Deck Doctors did a great job on an old deck that had some water damage and rot. They didn’t try to upsell us to an entirely new deck. They found a way to salvage as much as they could, fix the bad spots, and make the deck look new. They ensured, above all else, that the deck was safe and found a way to achieve that at a reasonable cost. I appreciate their professionalism and partnership. Thank you, Peter! Highly recommend!!

The Deck Doctors did a wonderful job refinishing our 25-year-old deck that was looking the worst for wear. They used a special filler for the rotting areas and were very thorough in identifying the areas that needed attention. They were very detailed and excellent at communicating what time they would arrive, and they always showed up on time. We had a very good experience and would highly recommend them.

Deck Doctors did an AMAZING job renewing my deck. They were professional, timely, and competitively priced. My deck came out beautiful! I thought I would have to rebuild the whole deck, but I did not! It looks brand new.

I couldn't be happier. Peter and Paul took a deck with crumbling stairs and made it new again. They were very competitively priced and did a superb job. I will definitely use them again for more outside work.

We had our house washed and the deck restored by Deck Doctors NE and are extremely satisfied with the results. There are many names quite similar—make sure you go to the website deckdoctorsne. We highly recommend this company.
Outstanding work. Excellent communication throughout the whole process. We are very happy with the final result!

Excellent customer service and pricing for our deck and ramp. The whole team listened to our needs and was kind, thoughtful, and helpful. They exceeded expectations in communication, timeliness of work and response, and cost.
